name: Angry Pakistani Fan
look: A TV still of a cricket crowd: a bald man in a navy puffer vest over a red and blue plaid shirt, stands with hands on hips and glares with a tight-lipped frown, surrounded by fans with green Pakistan flags.
use: A reaction image for being let down. The caption names something that failed to live up to expectations, and the man's hands-on-hips glare is the response, like a fan watching his team blow an easy chance.
examples: When the family-size bag of chips is mostly air
Me watching my code fail the same test after the fifth final fix
describe: bald man with hands on hips looking disappointed in a crowd
upset cricket fan glaring with his hands on his hips
guy in a plaid shirt and vest staring at the game unimpressed
annoyed spectator in the stands with green flags behind him
frustrated sports fan frowning with hands on his waist
origin: A Pakistan supporter caught on the TV broadcast of a 2019 Cricket World Cup match.
